title: Cache Invalidation

searches.query: "Cache Invalidation" interview race conditions stale reads
searches.result: success; exact-concept search executed, but independent frequency/rank/company evidence was insufficient; prompts are original production adaptations and technical decisions use checked primary sources

sources.title: Microsoft Azure Architecture: cache-aside pattern
sources.supportRationale: Application-owned loading and invalidation order; example ordering does not eliminate every concurrent stale fill.

sources.title: Redis: Pub/Sub delivery semantics
sources.supportRationale: At-most-once Pub/Sub delivery does not retain missed invalidations; official indexed text checked.

sources.title: Redis: client-side caching
sources.supportRationale: Local cache tracking/invalidation responsibilities and client scope.

sources.title: Nishtala et al.: Scaling Memcache at Facebook, NSDI 2013
sources.supportRationale: Original stale-fill/lease and load-control design; its extensions are not assumed to exist in stock Memcached.

sources.title: AWS Builders Library: caching challenges and strategies
sources.supportRationale: Measured cache value, modal failure behavior and origin protection.

sources.title: RFC 9111: HTTP Caching
sources.supportRationale: Shared/private storage, cache keys, validation and freshness semantics.

scenarios.theme: One worker misses an invalidation while disconnected. What happens on reconnect?
scenarios.assumptions: Local copies have no useful expiry and updates were sent only over Pub/Sub. What will you do?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.

direct-answer.rationale: Reviewed action: Treat the coherence gap explicitly: discard affected local state or reconcile/replay from retained authoritative change/version information

decision-costs.rationale: Reviewed cost/alternative: Rebuilds cost origin capacity; durable change streams add retention/consumer management

follow-up.rationale: Reviewed trap: Reconnecting alone cannot replay messages the selected Pub/Sub contract never retained.

scenarios.theme: An invalidation arrives before an old load completes. What must a fill check?
scenarios.assumptions: Version 2 is known obsolete-to-replace, but an earlier reader still holds version 1 and tries to populate. What will you implement?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.

concept-specificity.rationale: Applies Cache Invalidation to inflight old fill.

distinctness.rationale: Separate constraint/decision: An invalidation arrives before an old load completes. What must a fill check?

production-prompt.rationale: Prompt states a production failure or workload bound and asks for a justified response.

direct-answer.rationale: Reviewed action: Use a coordinated version/lease guard that can reject the old fill under an explicit retained metadata protocol, or route strict reads to authority

decision-costs.rationale: Reviewed cost/alternative: Guarding adds coordination; accepting a bounded stale display is simpler under a different requirement

follow-up.rationale: Reviewed trap: The cited Memcache lease design is an engineered extension, not a default feature of every cache.

scenarios.theme: A deleted object is recreated under the same key and an old fill resurrects its former view. What changes?
scenarios.assumptions: Readers from before deletion can complete after the new object exists. What identity rule will you choose?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.

concept-specificity.rationale: Applies Cache Invalidation to delete recreate.

distinctness.rationale: Separate constraint/decision: A deleted object is recreated under the same key and an old fill resurrects its former view. What changes?

production-prompt.rationale: Prompt states a production failure or workload bound and asks for a justified response.

direct-answer.rationale: Reviewed action: Use a version/generation that distinguishes the recreated entity and preserve deletion/guard information for the required in-flight horizon

decision-costs.rationale: Reviewed cost/alternative: Generations/tombstones cost retention and lookup work; never reusing object identity can be simpler

follow-up.rationale: Reviewed trap: A TTL on payloads alone does not stop an older load from beginning a new lifetime after deletion.
